title: Before I Learned the Words
canonicalSource: Before I Learned the Words — Song Project

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: The coffee's going cold beside the rain
I'm at the table, sitting here again
Across from where you used to be
I almost said your name into the room
A habit that the morning doesn't cure
It only finds me when I'm on my own

sections.name: Pre-Chorus 1
lines: And I don't know how you did it
Turned an ordinary room
Into something I can't sit in
Without looking up for you

sections.name: Chorus 1
lines: You turned into a memory
Before I learned the words
And everything I meant to say
Just lives here, getting worse
The rain still finds the window
Where your coffee used to cool

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: You held my hand before I asked you to
And let your head fall softly in the rain
We had a song — you said this one is ours
I hear it now in rooms where no one's sitting
It plays for no one, and I keep on listening
For your voice somewhere between the chords

sections.name: Pre-Chorus 2
lines: And I should've known by then
That nothing made of rain could stay
Some people pass like weather
Close enough to feel, too far to save

sections.name: Bridge
lines: I didn't know the last time was the last
Your hand in mine — and then it wasn't
And everything I'd saved to tell you
Lived and died inside a breath
I held you like tomorrow
Was a thing that still belonged to us

sections.name: Final Chorus
lines: You turned into a memory
Before I learned the words
And everything I meant to say
Still lives here — getting worse
The rain still finds the window
Where your chair still holds your shape
You left me mid-conversation
And I'm still…
Talking to you

sections.name: Outro
lines: And when it rains...
I still sit across from you
